tools.name: local_amenities_discover
tools.description: Free peek: up to 5 nearby OSM amenities for a UK postcode / outcode (e.g. M1). Geocodes via postcodes.io. Cached 24h. OSM-only (© OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: local_amenities_pack
tools.description: Paid pack of nearby UK amenities (shops, cafes, pubs, etc.) for a postcode/outcode. OSM-only (© OpenStreetMap contributors / ODbL). Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: local_context_pack
tools.description: Paid compound local-context pack: OSM amenities + density stats + honest risk_flags. Returns Stripe Checkout URL (£0.49). Soft-Offer outbound is OFF.

tools.name: redeem_pack
tools.description: Instructions to redeem a paid Stripe Checkout session. Pass session_id from checkout.
